attr.title: Jetboard Joust
attr.desc: Fast & fluid arcade-style shooter with roguelike elements! Take flight on a lethal rocket-powered jetboard, blasting alien invaders with an explosive arsenal of ridiculous weaponry. Face off against massive, multi-stage bosses. Jetboard Joust resurrects the spirit of the arcade for the 21st century!
attr.inst:
Buy and install the Linux version of Jetboard Joust from Steam or GOG. Copy all the game assets to jetboardjoust/gamedata.
For GOG, you can place the offline installer in jetboardjoust/gamedata as well.
attr.inst_md:
1) Purchase the game from Steam or GOG  
2) Buy and install the Linux version of Jetboard Joust. If you are using windows, use the following steam command: download_depot download_depot 1181600 1181603 2089458011753465431  
3) Copy all the assets to jetboardjoust/gamedata. For GOG you can drop the offline installer in jetboardjoust/gamedata as well.  
4) Run Jetboard Joust.sh. The first startup will patch the game to make it run on devices with 1GB RAM
